market_question: Will US withdraw from NATO before 2027?
reasoning: While President Trump has made hostile remarks about NATO and threatened withdrawal, a formal denunciation under Article 13 is a drastic step he has never taken. His incentives lean toward claiming credit for strengthening the alliance rather than destroying it, and substantial political, diplomatic, and bureaucratic headwinds make the 8.6% market price too high. I estimate a 6% true probability, which falls outside the 5% skip threshold.
evidence_points: Trump never withdrew from NATO during his first term despite persistent threats, undermining the narrative that he will imminently do so.
A formal withdrawal would face immense political blowback, including from within his own party, and damage US leadership without clear political gain.
The resolution explicitly excludes a mere exit from NATO’s integrated command structure, requiring the much higher bar of a notice of denunciation.
sources_consulted: NATO Article 13 text and withdrawal procedure
